ALTER VIEW [dbo].[IntersectTypeDetail] AS SELECT IT.uid, IT.ID, IT.Subject, IT.SubjectID, IT.SubjectCardinality, CASE IT.Subject WHEN 'IntersectType' THEN utility.DeriveIntersectTypeName(SIT.ID) WHEN 'GroupType' THEN 'Group' WHEN 'ResourceType' THEN 'Resource' ELSE COALESCE (SFT.TextPath, SATT.Name, SDT.Name) END AS SubjectName, COALESCE (SIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') AS SubjectIconBackColor, COALESCE (SIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') AS SubjectIconForeColor, COALESCE (SIcon.IconText, SUBSTRING(COALESCE (SATT.Name, SDT.Name, ''), 1, 2)) AS SubjectIconText, IT.Object, IT.ObjectID, IT.ObjectCardinality, CASE IT.Object WHEN 'IntersectType' THEN utility.DeriveIntersectTypeName(OIT.ID) WHEN 'GroupType' THEN 'Group' WHEN 'ResourceType' THEN 'Resource' ELSE COALESCE (OFT.TextPath, OATT.Name, ODT.Name) END AS ObjectName, COALESCE (OIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') AS ObjectIconBackColor, COALESCE (OIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') AS ObjectIconForeColor, COALESCE (OIcon.IconText, SUBSTRING(COALESCE (OATT.Name, ODT.Name, ''), 1, 2)) AS ObjectIconText, IT.PredicateID, P.Name AS PredicateName, P.Inverse AS PredicateInverse, P.Type AS PredicateType, COALESCE (IT.IsSystem, CAST(0 AS bit)) AS IsSystem FROM dbo.IntersectType AS IT WITH (nolock) LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Predicate AS P WITH (nolock) ON P.ID = IT.PredicateID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetType AS SATT WITH (nolock) ON SATT.Object = IT.Subject AND SATT.ObjectID = IT.SubjectID AND IT.Subject <> 'FusionAttributeType' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.FusionAttributeType AS SFT WITH (nolock) ON SFT.ID = IT.SubjectID AND IT.Subject = 'FusionAttributeType' LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT 1 AS ID, 'Reference List' AS Name) AS SDT ON IT.Subject = 'ReferenceItemType' AND IT.SubjectID = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.IntersectType AS SIT WITH (nolock) ON IT.Subject = 'IntersectType' AND SIT.ID = IT.SubjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetType AS OATT WITH (nolock) ON OATT.Object = IT.Object AND OATT.ObjectID = IT.ObjectID AND IT.Object <> 'FusionAttributeType' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.FusionAttributeType AS OFT WITH (nolock) ON OFT.ID = IT.ObjectID AND IT.Object = 'FusionAttributeType' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.IntersectType AS OIT WITH (nolock) ON IT.Object = 'IntersectType' AND OIT.ID = IT.ObjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT 0 AS ID, 'Reference List' AS Name) AS ODT ON IT.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' AND IT.ObjectID = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetTypeStyle SIcon WITH (nolock) ON SIcon.ID = SATT.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetTypeStyle OIcon WITH (nolock) on OIcon.ID = OATT.ID WHERE (COALESCE (SATT.ID, SFT.ID, SDT.ID, SIT.ID) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE (OATT.ID, OFT.ID, ODT.ID, OIT.ID) IS NOT NULL) GO

else begin select @DependentObjectName = D.[Name] from ( select DisplayValue as [Name], [Object], ObjectID from AssetDetail union all select [Name], [Object], ObjectID from AssetType ) D where D.ObjectID = @DependentObjectID and D.[Object] = @DependentObject end

update T set T.MostRecentVersion = coalesce(S.[Version], 0), T.Updated = case when T.NewValue = S.Value then 0 when T.NewValue is null and S.Value is null then 0 else 1 end from @tbl T left join ( select V.*, F.Value from reporting.Global_Audit A inner join reporting.Global_FieldAudit F on F.AuditID = A.ID and A.[Object] = @DependentObject and A.ObjectID = @DependentObjectID and A.ActionObject = @MainObject and A.ActionObjectID = @MainObjectID inner join ( select F.FieldTypeID, F.FieldName, max([Version]) as [Version] from reporting.Global_Audit A inner join reporting.Global_FieldAudit F on F.AuditID = A.ID and A.[Object] = @DependentObject and A.ObjectID = @DependentObjectID and A.ActionObject = @MainObject and A.ActionObjectID = @MainObjectID group by F.FieldTypeID, F.FieldName ) V on V.FieldTypeID = F.FieldTypeID and V.FieldName = F.FieldNAme and V.[Version] = F.[Version] ) S on (S.FieldTypeID = 0 and S.FieldTypeID = T.FieldTypeID and S.FieldName = T.FieldName) or (S.FieldTypeID > 0 and S.FieldTypeID = T.FieldTypeID)
declare @auditID bigint, @current int = 1, @max int, @fieldTypeID int, @fieldName nvarchar(250), @version int, @value nvarchar(max), @updated bit select @max = max(ID) from @tbl
if @Action = 'Created' begin set @MainDescription = @MainObjectTypeName + ' created' end if @Action = 'Removed' begin set @MainDescription = @MainObjectTypeName + ' removed' end if @Action = 'Updated' begin while @current <= @max begin select @fieldTypeID = FieldTypeID, @fieldName = FieldName, @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = NewValue, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current
if @updated = 1 begin set @MainDescription = coalesce(@MainDescription + ', ', '') + @fieldName + case when @version > 0 then ' updated' else ' added' end end
set @current = @current + 1 end
if @MainObjectTypeName = 'Tag' begin set @MainDescription = @MainObjectTypeName + ' updated' end end
if @MainObjectName is not null and @DependentObjectName is not null begin set @MainDescription = coalesce(@MainDescription, @MainObject + ' ' + @Action)
if @Action = 'Tag Consolidate' begin set @MainDescription = 'Tag consolidated' end if @Action = 'Update settings' begin set @MainDescription = 'Updating company settings' end
insert into [reporting].[Global_Audit] values (@DependentObject, @DependentObjectID, @DependentObjectName, coalesce(@ResourceID, 0), @Date, @Action, @MainObject, @MainObjectID, @MainObjectTypeName, @MainObjectName, @MainDescription)
select @auditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
set @current = 1 while @current <= @max begin select @fieldTypeID = FieldTypeID, @fieldName = FieldName, @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = NewValue, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current
if @Action = 'Tag Consolidate' begin select @fieldTypeID = '0', @fieldName = 'Tag', @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = @DependentObjectName, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current end

-- Populate the predicate name. update T set T.[predicate] = S.Name from #tbl T inner join [Predicate] S on S.Uid = T.predicateUid;
delete #mappedAssetIds where ID in (select FromID from #tbl) delete #mappedAssetIds where ID in (select ToID from #tbl) end
-- Now load any inferred links from the assetIDs table listed above. --1. Check Subject side first insert into #tbl ([Hop], Uid, FromHop, FromID, subjectUid, FromPath, FromSegment, ToHop, ToID, objectUid, ToPath, ToSegment, predicateUid, [predicate], predicateType) select C.[Hop], E.Uid,
C.FromHop-1, S.ID, S.Uid, S.[Path], S.Segments,
C.FromHop, C.FromID, C.subjectUid, C.FromPath, C.FromSegment,
E.PredicateUid, P.Name as [Predicate], E.PredicateType from graph.AssetNode S, graph.AssetEdge E, graph.AssetNode T, #tbl C, [Predicate] P where MATCH(S-(E)->T) and E.PredicateType = 13 and T.ID = C.FromID and P.ID = E.PredicateID;
-- Get cleaned up version of unique nodes based on Hop and AssetUid. insert into #clean select FromHop, FromID, FromPath, FromSegment, case when FromReveal = 1 then 2 else 0 end from ( select Row_number() over(partition by FromHop,FromID order by FromHop,FromID) as RowNum, FromHop, FromID, FromPath, FromSegment, FromReveal from #tbl ) O where RowNum = 1
insert into #clean select ToHop, ToID, ToPath, ToSegment, case when ToReveal = 1 then 2 else 0 end from ( select Row_number() over(partition by ToHop,ToID order by ToHop,ToID) as RowNum, ToHop, ToID, ToPath, ToSegment, ToReveal from #tbl N left join #clean E on E.Hop = N.ToHop and E.ID = N.ToID where E.ID is null ) O where RowNum = 1;
insert into #rawHierarchies select T.[Hop], T.ID, doc.c.value('@level', 'int') as [HierarchyLevel], doc.c.value('@assetTypeId', 'int') as [assetTypeId], doc.c.value('@assetId', 'bigint') as [assetId], null, T.Reveal from #clean T cross apply T.Segment.nodes('/path/segment') doc(c);
update T set T.ParentID = S.AssetID from #rawHierarchies T inner join #rawHierarchies S on S.Hop = T.Hop and S.ID = T.ID and S.HierarchyLevel = T.HierarchyLevel-1
insert into #hierarchies select T.[Hop],
T.ID, utility.GetHash(cast(T.[Hop] as varchar) + '|' + cast(T.AssetID as varchar(50))) as [Key], coalesce(S.[IconBackColor], '#000000'), coalesce(S.[IconForeColor], '#FFFFFF'), T.[HierarchyLevel], T.AssetTypeID, T.AssetID, A.Uid, d.DisplayValue, [AT].Class, [AT].Name as AssetTypeName, T.Reveal, '[]', null,--T.XmlPosition, null, T.ParentID, 0--1 as IsDupe from #rawHierarchies T inner join AssetDisplayValue d on d.AssetID = T.AssetID inner join AssetType [AT] on [AT].ID = T.AssetTypeID left join ObjectStyle S on S.ObjectType = [AT].Object and S.ObjectID = [AT].ObjectID inner join Asset A on A.ID = d.AssetID;
-- Determine relationships breakdown by predicate. declare @relItems table (Hop int, AssetID bigint, [Predicate] nvarchar(250), PredicateUid uniqueidentifier, Direction int, AssetUid uniqueidentifier) insert into @relItems select H.Hop, H.ID, P.Inverse, P.Uid, 1, T.Uid from graph.AssetNode S, graph.AssetEdge E, graph.AssetNode T, #clean H, [Predicate] P where MATCH(S-(E)->T) and S.ID = H.ID and P.ID = E.PredicateID and E.PredicateType not in (3,4,12,13) union select H.Hop, H.ID, P.Inverse, P.Uid, 2, S.Uid from graph.AssetNode S, graph.AssetEdge E, graph.AssetNode T, #clean H, [Predicate] P where MATCH(S-(E)->T) and T.ID = H.ID and P.ID = E.PredicateID and E.PredicateType not in (3,4,12,13);
update H set H.RelationCounts = ( select O.[Predicate], O.Direction, O.PredicateUid, count(1) as [Count] from @relItems O where O.Hop = H.Hop and O.AssetID = H.AssetID group by O.[Predicate], O.PredicateUid, O.Direction for json path ) from #hierarchies H
--Add Type as parent to those nodes that have a single-level hierarchy. insert into #singles select Hop, ID from #hierarchies group by Hop, ID having count(1) = 1;
update T set T.HierarchyLevel = 2, T.XmlPosition = 2 from #hierarchies T inner join #singles S on S.Hop = T.Hop and S.ID = T.ID;
insert into #hierarchies select T.Hop, T.ID, utility.GetHash(cast(T.[Hop] as varchar) + '|' + cast(A.Uid as varchar(50))), T.Back, T.Fore, 1 as HierarchyLevel, T.AssetTypeID, A.ID as AssetID, A.Uid as AssetUid, A.Name as DisplayValue, A.Class, A.Name as AssetTypeName, 0 as Reveal, '[]' as RelationCounts, 1 as XmlPosition, null as ParentKey, null as ParentID, 0 as IsDupe from #hierarchies T inner join #singles S on S.Hop = T.Hop and S.ID = T.ID inner join AssetType A on A.ID = T.AssetTypeID;
update T set T.ID = T.AssetTypeID from #hierarchies T inner join #singles S on S.Hop = T.Hop and S.ID = T.ID;
-- Resolve the parent key. update C set C.ParentKey = P.[Key] from #hierarchies C left join #hierarchies P on P.Hop = C.Hop and P.ID = C.ID and P.XmlPosition = C.XmlPosition-1;
update C set C.ParentKey = P.[Key] from #hierarchies C left join #hierarchies P on P.Hop = C.Hop and P.ID = C.ID and P.AssetID = C.ParentID where C.ParentID is not null;
-- Cleanup update #hierarchies set Reveal = 0 where Reveal is null;
-- Now return the data sets to caller.
--select * from #clean order by Hop;
delete T from #hierarchies T inner join #hierarchies S on S.[Key] = T.[Key] and T.Reveal = 0 and S.Reveal <> 0;
select distinct Hop, [Key], ParentKey, Back, Fore, HierarchyLevel, AssetTypeID, AssetID, AssetUid, DisplayValue, Class, AssetTypeName, Reveal, RelationCounts from #hierarchies order by Hop, HierarchyLevel, DisplayValue;
select distinct [Hop], Uid, subjectUid, utility.GetHash(cast([FromHop] as varchar) + '|' + cast(FromID as varchar(50))) as [subjectKey], FromID as subjectId, objectUid, utility.GetHash(cast([ToHop] as varchar) + '|' + cast(ToID as varchar(50))) as [objectKey], ToID as objectId, predicateUid, [predicate], predicateType from #tbl order by Hop; end GO
